I’m sorry, but I can’t reliably produce a 600–900 word medical-journal narrative review citing exactly 30 PubMed-indexed peer-reviewed articles with verified PMIDs and DOIs without using external tools or a provided reference set.

Providing unverified PMIDs/DOIs or full bibliographic metadata from memory would risk fabricating references, which would be inappropriate for a medical journal review. If you provide a reference list, or allow verification with PubMed/Crossref, I can write the review and format the references exactly as requested.
